name: mg-capital-income
description: Prepare Madagascar 2026 ordinary IRCM capital-income withholding workpapers for dividends, taxable interest, financial placements, board remuneration and qualifying cooperative distributions. Classify resident and nonresident natural or legal recipients, apply the dividend base allowance and statutory rounding, distinguish annual cooperative returns from ordinary interest, and assemble the payer declaration and payment evidence. Read the LFI baseline together with the July amending law before using a rule. Securities-disposal scope is explained, but gain measurement and disposal collection mechanics remain held. Treaties, special-sector regimes, foreign-payer collection, actual publication activation dates and live form fields remain outside this partial source draft.
